turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - cdft_piezo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose
    properties are NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal chemistry,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, select the 5
candidates with the LARGEST piezoelectric strain coefficient max|d_ij| (in
pC/N) that also satisfy a low-leakage requirement: the band gap must be at
least 5 eV. Band gaps are NOT given for the pool -- you must infer them. A
selected candidate whose band gap is below the threshold scores zero.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The piezoelectric strain tensor vanishes identically in any structure possessing an inversion center, so the pool was first screened for the absence of inversion (from lattice type, occupied Wyckoff positions and the impossibility of pairing every atom with an inverted partner). Among the surviving non-centrosymmetric crystals a second, independent filter was applied: only compositions built from elements that empirically produce gaps \(\ge5\,\mathrm{eV}\) (alkali/alkaline-earth metals, Al, Si, P, Be, F, O, H, Cl in high oxidation states) were retained. Sulfides, selenides, phosphides, nitrides of Ga/Zn/Ge, Bi/Pb/Sb compounds and all metallic alloys were discarded because their gaps lie well below the leakage threshold.

The five crystals that remain were then ranked by the expected magnitude of \(\max|d_{ij}|\). The ranking follows established structure–property trends:
- a polar perovskite distortion in a soft chloride lattice (large Born charges, low elastic moduli) produces the highest coefficients,
- a polar molecular packing of a chloride network is next,
- a low-symmetry phosphate (KDP-like) follows,
- a hydrogen-bonded hydroxide network and a melilite silicate (both stiffer) complete the list.

Thus the ordered selection is c011, c048, c005, c079, c038.

Final: c011, c048, c005, c079, c038
